hyperedges.label: External dependencies protected by Polly pipeline

nodes.label: YarPhoenix.Catalog (domain core)
nodes.rationale: Domain core; supporting modules may reference it, but Catalog references only Shared.

nodes.label: Book entity
nodes.rationale: Single entity; external record unique by (Provider, ExternalId) pair, not ExternalId alone. Provider: OpenLibrary or InternetArchive.

nodes.label: CI/CD workflow (backend.yml)
nodes.rationale: HTTPS mandatory because the frontend on gh-pages is HTTPS-only and mixed content is blocked.

nodes.label: JWT secret config
nodes.rationale: Jwt:Secret must be at least 32 chars; fail fast on startup.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith
nodes.rationale: Deliberate choice per TechSpec section 3: not microservices. Each module has its own project, DbContext and DB schema.

nodes.label: OpenAPI contract with frontend
nodes.rationale: Every endpoint with a body needs .Produces<T>() because lambdas return IResult; JsonNumberHandling.Strict so schema does not describe numbers as number-or-string.

nodes.label: Open Library
nodes.rationale: Blocked by the ISP; needs proxy locally and an egress proxy on the VPS in Russia. Offline stub server on :5090 for development.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.rationale: Container on 127.0.0.1:5433 because a native Windows Postgres occupies 5432.

nodes.label: Polly resilience pipeline
nodes.rationale: Every external dependency gets its own pipeline: Retry(2, no 429/4xx), CircuitBreaker(0.5/10/30s/15s), Timeout 20s per attempt. Fallback returns a value, never throws: assistant returns 200 + available:false, catalog returns 503 with clear message when Open Library is down, email failure is a soft response not 500.

nodes.label: Result/Error pattern
nodes.rationale: Used instead of exceptions in business logic.

nodes.label: Reading streak and achievements
nodes.rationale: Soft O(1) streak (CurrentStreak/LongestStreak/LastActiveDate, user timezone), lazy expiry on read; achievements 10/30/50/100 granted idempotently and never revoked.

nodes.label: Two worlds (catalog vs reader/AI)
nodes.rationale: World A (catalog) is Open Library metadata; world B (reader and AI) requires a file (Book.FileId in MinIO). The text opens the AI, not the shelf. Bridges: EPUB matching (ISBN then title+author) and ocaid.

nodes.label: UserBook entity
nodes.rationale: Status enum (WantToRead|Reading|Read) plus separate IsFavorite flag; CFI position stored here; Read action upserts into Reading.

nodes.label: Backend on VPS (Docker Compose prod profile)
nodes.norm_label: backend on vps (docker compose prod profile)

nodes.label: Caddy auto-TLS
nodes.rationale: Caddy obtains certificates via ACME on ports 80/443; sslip.io domain can be used without buying a domain. Also proxies /avatars to MinIO.

nodes.label: CI deploy job (GHCR + SSH)
nodes.rationale: Deploy is manual only (Run workflow); SSH uses StrictHostKeyChecking=yes with DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS so first server response is not trusted.

nodes.label: CORS and mixed-content verification
nodes.rationale: Backend allows FRONTEND_ORIGIN; all requests must use https to avoid mixed content blocking.

nodes.label: EGRESS_PROXY
nodes.rationale: Needed if the VPS provider blocks archive.org / api.anthropic.com (sections 5.1.2, 8).

nodes.label: Rollback by SHA image
nodes.rationale: Each image tagged with commit SHA; EF migrations are not rolled back, so check old-code compatibility with new schema.

nodes.label: Persistent volumes pg-data / minio-data
nodes.rationale: Critical (11.2): hold users/shelves/progress and book files; must not be deleted on container recreation.

nodes.label: Anti-spoiler AI assistant (CFI cut)
nodes.rationale: Anti-spoiler at the data level (section 7.2): server opens EPUB from MinIO, extracts text by spine chapters, resolves CFI to a read boundary; any CFI ambiguity shifts the boundary backward, never forward. Cheap templates go to Haiku, interpretive ones to Sonnet.

nodes.label: Auth: Identity + JWT + refresh rotation
nodes.rationale: Refresh tokens stored only as SHA-256 hash and rotated; reuse of a rotated token is treated as theft and all sessions are revoked.

nodes.label: Modular monolith (README)
nodes.rationale: Hard module boundaries allow extracting a module into a service later, without paying the distributed-system tax now.

nodes.label: Public-domain check (whitelist + lending filter)
nodes.rationale: PD status is verified by us (classic-author whitelist plus filtering IA lending books), not by third-party site tags (section 5.1.2).

nodes.label: Polly resilience (README)
nodes.rationale: Retry, CircuitBreaker, Timeout per boundary via Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience; fallback returns a value so assistant failure does not crash the reader request (200 available:false, not 500).

nodes.label: Tech stack (EF Core, HybridCache, xUnit)
nodes.rationale: OpenAPI document (Development only) is the source of TypeScript types for the frontend; types are generated, not hand-written.

nodes.label: Two content worlds (README)
nodes.rationale: ExternalId+Provider make a book visible in catalog (world A); FileId makes it readable with AI (world B). Public-domain books are lazily downloaded into MinIO on Read, giving both metadata and file.

nodes.label: DEPLOY runbook
nodes.rationale: Two separate targets (TechSpec 11.1): backend on VPS Docker, frontend on GitHub Pages; different origins so CORS and HTTPS are mandatory (11.4).

nodes.label: README: YarPhoenix Library API
nodes.rationale: Portfolio project for a C#/.NET internship; bet on engineering maturity: simple architecture, resilience at external boundaries, legal cleanliness of the domain.
